reviewed_cases.source: 最終局面を迎えたペナントレース、ここまできて大魚を逸するわけにはいかない。今こそ最後の力を振り絞るときだ！
reviewed_cases.english: The pennant race is down to the wire. We have come too far to let it slip away. Give it everything you have left!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The pennant race has reached its final stages—we can’t let the big prize slip away now that we’ve come this far. Now is the time to give it everything we’ve got!

reviewed_cases.source: ついに迎えたプレーオフ。すべてのプレイにわずかな隙も許されない。今こそリーグの王者をかけての頂上決戦！
reviewed_cases.english: The playoffs are here. Every play counts as we fight for the league title.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The playoffs are finally here. There’s no room for even the slightest mistake in every play. Now is the time for the ultimate showdown to determine the league champion!

reviewed_cases.source: 「日本一」の称号をえることができる真の王者はただ１チーム。@eは強敵だが頂に最後に立つのはわがチームだ！
reviewed_cases.english: Only one team can be Japan Series champion. @e will be tough, but we can take the title.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Only one team can earn the title of “Japan’s Best.” @e is a formidable opponent, but in the end, it will be our team standing at the top!

reviewed_cases.source: ついに前半戦もこの@eとの対決を最後に終了。後半戦を気持ちよく滑り出すためにもこの対決はなんとかモノにしたい。
reviewed_cases.english: The series against @e closes out the first half. Win it and carry that momentum into the second half.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The first half of the season finally comes to an end with this matchup against @e. We need to win this game to get the second half off to a strong start.

reviewed_cases.source: 夢の競演・オールスターにわがチームからも@t選手が出場することとなった。チームの代表として恥ずかしくない結果を残してきてほしい。
reviewed_cases.english: @t will represent us at the All-Star Game. Let's see what our player can do on that stage.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t from our team will be participating in the All-Star Game, a dream showdown. We hope he’ll deliver results that do our team proud.

reviewed_cases.source: ついに開幕するペナントレース。「開幕の１勝」はただの１勝ではない@n何としてもこの一戦は勝利をつかみ取る！
reviewed_cases.english: Opening Day is here, and the first win means more than any other.@nFind a way to win this one!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The pennant race is finally kicking off. “That first win of the season” isn’t just any win—@nwe must secure victory in this game at all costs!

reviewed_cases.source: 今シーズン初対決を迎える@e。出鼻をくじいて苦手意識をうえ付けるためにもこの初対決、引く訳にはいかない！
reviewed_cases.english: This is our first series against @e. Get off to a strong start and give them a reason to worry next time.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @e and I are set to face off for the first time this season. To knock the wind out of their sails right from the start and instill a sense of fear in them, I absolutely cannot back down in this first matchup!

reviewed_cases.source: なに気なく見た新聞記事に「足を引っ張る@t選手、監督も見限り」といった見出しが躍っていた。せめてこの記事を発奮材料に奮起してくれれば…
reviewed_cases.english: The papers say @t is holding us back and has lost the manager's trust. Let's hope the headline lights a fire.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: I happened to glance at a newspaper article with a headline that read, “Player @t is holding the team back; even the manager has given up on him.” I just hope he’ll use this article as motivation to pull himself together…

reviewed_cases.source: 野手コーチの提案で走塁の新しいトレーニングを導入することにした。果たして選手たちへの効果はどうだろうか。
reviewed_cases.english: The fielding coach suggested a new baserunning drill. Let's see how much it helps the team.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Based on a suggestion from the fielding coach, we decided to introduce a new baserunning training regimen. I wonder how effective it will be for the players.

reviewed_cases.source: さまざまな事件を経て野球人気の低迷が叫ばれる昨今、われわれにできることはファンが喜ぶプレイをすること。ファンには勝利で応えたい！
reviewed_cases.english: Baseball's popularity is slipping. We can give fans something to cheer about by winning and playing well.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: With baseball’s popularity said to be on the decline following various incidents, what we can do is play in a way that delights our fans. We want to repay our fans with victories!

reviewed_cases.source: 投手陣の不調が問題となっている。本社は戦力を放出してのトレードも画策中のようだ。まだ優勝が狙えるチームだと証明せねば。
reviewed_cases.english: Our pitchers are struggling, and ownership is considering a trade. Show them this roster can still contend.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The pitching staff’s slump has become a problem. Headquarters appears to be planning trades that would involve releasing players. We must prove that this team can still contend for the championship.

reviewed_cases.source: 今ひとつ波に乗り切れないチームにテコ入れをということか、フロントは新外国人の獲得を通知してきた。新戦力の加入は悪いことではないのだが…
reviewed_cases.english: The front office signed a foreign player to shake up a struggling team. Let's see what the new arrival can do.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Perhaps in an effort to turn things around for a team that hasn’t quite found its stride, the front office has announced the signing of a new foreign player. While adding a new player to the roster isn’t a bad thing, though…

reviewed_cases.source: 連敗で沈滞ムードの中、大きな声を出しムードを変えようとしている@t選手がいた。こういう選手が活躍すれば流れも変わるのだが。
reviewed_cases.english: The losing streak has made the clubhouse quiet, but @t is trying to lift the mood. A big game could turn things around.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Amid a slump caused by a losing streak, Player @t was trying to lift the team’s spirits by shouting loudly. If a player like this can step up, it might just turn the tide.

reviewed_cases.source: リリーフ陣に疲れの色が見え始めている。この状況を打開するためにも、先発陣を完投させリリーフの負担を減らすことができれば…
reviewed_cases.english: The bullpen is wearing down. A complete game from a starter would give our relievers a much-needed break.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Signs of fatigue are beginning to show among the relief pitchers. To turn this situation around, if only we could get our starting pitchers to go the distance and reduce the burden on the relief corps…

reviewed_cases.source: 過酷なペナントでの戦いで選手達の疲労もたまってきている。@t選手は特にその色が濃く出ている様子。何とか休養を与えてやりたいが。
reviewed_cases.english: The season is taking a toll, especially on @t. Find a way to give that player a day off.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Fatigue is starting to set in among the players as they battle through the grueling pennant race. Player @t seems to be showing particularly strong signs of it. I really want to find a way to give him some rest.

reviewed_cases.source: 最近若い投手達が同じような冊子を持っているのに気付き、話を聞くと「コーチに貰った教材だ」と言う。良い効果が出ることを期待しよう。
reviewed_cases.english: The young pitchers are studying a booklet from their coach. Let's see if the lessons show up on the field.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: I recently noticed that some young pitchers have similar booklets, and when I asked them about it, they said, “Our coach gave them to us as study materials.” Let’s hope this has a positive effect.

reviewed_cases.source: チームはこれからしばらく敵地での試合が続くことになる。敵地のファンを黙らせるようなゲームをしてチームに勢いをつけたいものだが。
reviewed_cases.english: We have a long road trip ahead. Silence the home crowds and use those wins to build momentum.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The team will be playing a series of away games for the foreseeable future. We’d like to play well enough to silence the opposing fans and build momentum for the team.

reviewed_cases.source: 過酷さを増すペナントレース。投手コーチより、苦しい調整が続く@t選手には次回の先発日を早めに通知しておくのはどうかという提案があった。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has struggled to get ready between starts. The pitching coach suggests announcing the next start early.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The pennant race is becoming increasingly grueling. The pitching coach suggested that, since Player @t has been struggling with his adjustments, perhaps they should notify him of his next start date a little earlier.

reviewed_cases.source: どうしても落としたくない@eとのこの一戦。投手コーチは、先発に初回から飛ばさせて５回以降を継投で乗り切るという作戦を提案してきた。
reviewed_cases.english: We need this win against @e. The pitching coach wants the starter to go hard early, then use the bullpen from the fifth on.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: This is a game against @e that we absolutely cannot lose. The pitching coach has proposed a strategy where the starting pitcher goes all out from the first inning, and we’ll rely on relief pitchers to get through the fifth inning and beyond.

reviewed_cases.source: 連勝で勢いにのるチーム。試合前の選手たちの表情もやわらかい。そんな中唯一思い悩んだ顔をする@t選手がいた。いち早い復活が待たれるのだが…
reviewed_cases.english: The winning streak has lifted everyone except @t, who still looks worried. We need that player back in form soon.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The team is riding a wave of momentum with a winning streak. The players look relaxed before the game. Amidst this, however, one player—@t—was the only one with a worried look on his face. We’re hoping for his quick return…

reviewed_cases.source: 球団側はファンサービスとして、チームの連勝につき球場内で販売する飲食品の値段を３％ずつ引いていくというキャンペーンを始めたようだ。
reviewed_cases.english: The team is cutting ballpark food and drink prices by 3 percent for each win in the streak. Keep it going for the fans.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It appears the team has launched a fan appreciation campaign in which the prices of food and beverages sold at the stadium are reduced by 3% for each consecutive win the team achieves.

reviewed_cases.source: 夏真っ盛り、選手たちもスタンドに混じる子供の声が気になるようで「がんばれ～！ホームランだぁ！」といった声に気合が入っているようだ。
reviewed_cases.english: It's midsummer, and the kids in the stands are calling for home runs. The players are fired up to give them one.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It’s the height of summer, and the players seem to be paying attention to the children’s voices in the stands; shouts like “Go for it! Home run!” seem to be spurring them on.

reviewed_cases.source: 昨年度の観客動員をまもなく上回る見込みらしく、球団は新たなサービスも考えているらしい。現場も勝利という形でバックアップしたいものだ。
reviewed_cases.english: We're about to top last year's attendance. The club is looking for ways to thank the fans. Let's give them a win.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It appears attendance is on track to surpass last year’s figures shortly, and the team is reportedly considering new services. We hope the players on the field will back this up with victories.

reviewed_cases.source: 連敗。緊急ミーティングではチームの置かれている状況について厳しい話が相次ぎ、選手たちの元気のなさが気になるという意見が相次いだ。
reviewed_cases.english: We called an emergency meeting about the losing streak. The players look flat, and everyone knows we need a spark.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: A losing streak. At an emergency meeting, a series of harsh comments were made about the team’s current situation, and many expressed concern about the players’ lack of energy.

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多の安打もついに@x本間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career hits.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The countless hits I’ve racked up are finally nearing @x. @n I’ll achieve this great milestone with my own two hands!

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多の本塁打もついに@x本間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career home runs.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The countless home runs I’ve hit over the years are finally nearing @x. @n I’ll achieve this great milestone with my own two hands!

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多の盗塁もついに@x個間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career stolen bases.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The countless stolen bases I’ve racked up are finally nearing @x. I’ll achieve this great milestone with my own two hands!

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多の勝ち星もついに@x勝間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career wins.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: With countless victories under our belt, we’re finally on the verge of @x wins. @n Let’s achieve this monumental milestone with our own hands!

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多のセーブもついに@xセーブ間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career saves.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: With countless saves under my belt, I’m finally nearing @x saves. @n I’ll achieve this monumental record with my own two hands!

reviewed_cases.source: 積み重ねてきた数多の奪三振もついに@x個間近。@nこの大記録達成をこの手で！
reviewed_cases.english: Closing in on @x career strikeouts.@nGo make history!
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The countless strikeouts I’ve racked up are finally nearing @x. I’ll achieve this great milestone with my own two hands!

reviewed_cases.source: スタメンとして出場し続けている@t選手ですが、結果が出ず他選手から起用に不満が上がっているようです。何らかの対策が必要かもしれません。
reviewed_cases.english: @t keeps starting without producing, and teammates are questioning the decision. It may be time to act.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t has been a regular starter, but since he hasn’t been producing results, other players seem to be voicing dissatisfaction with his continued selection. Some kind of action may be necessary.

reviewed_cases.source: 現在@eにはかなり負け越して勢いをそがれている。変な苦手意識を選手が持たないようにするためにも今節対戦では勝ち越しを狙っていく！
reviewed_cases.english: @e has had our number this season. Win this series before our players start expecting to lose.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: We’re currently trailing @e by quite a bit, which has dampened our momentum. To prevent our players from developing an irrational fear of them, we’re aiming to come out on top in this round’s matchup!

reviewed_cases.source: ３連敗はチームのムードを悪くし、勢いをなくしてしまう。そして何よりもファンのためにも避けなければならない。次の試合は必勝の態勢で臨む！！
reviewed_cases.english: A third straight loss would hurt morale and cost us momentum. For the fans and the team, we have to win the next game.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Three consecutive losses dampen the team’s morale and sap its momentum. Above all, we must avoid this for the sake of our fans. We’ll approach the next game with a must-win attitude!!

reviewed_cases.source: 最近思うような結果が出ていない@t選手ですが、かなり深刻に悩んでいるようです。僅かでも結果が出れば上昇のきっかけを掴めると思うのですが。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is taking this slump hard. Even a small success could help turn it around.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t hasn’t been producing the results he’d hoped for lately, and he seems to be taking it quite hard. I think even the slightest improvement in his performance could give him the momentum he needs to turn things around.

reviewed_cases.source: 最近の@t選手は考えすぎで、思うようなピッチングができていないようです。深刻な事態になる前に、何かきっかけをつかんでくれればよいのですが。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is overthinking on the mound. One good outing could help before the problem gets worse.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Lately, Player @t seems to be overthinking things and isn’t pitching the way he’d like to. I hope he can find a way to turn things around before the situation gets serious.

reviewed_cases.source: 次の相手はすぐ上位にいる@e。この戦いの結果でチームはＡクラスにグッと近くなる。長いペナントを戦い抜くには、こういった節目での勝負強さがほしい。
reviewed_cases.english: @e is just ahead of us. A good series would move us closer to the top three. These are the games a contender has to win.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Our next opponent is @e, who is right above us in the standings. The outcome of this game will bring our team much closer to the A Class. To make it through the long pennant race, we need to show resilience in crucial moments like this.

reviewed_cases.source: 次のカードの結果次第で、５割復帰が見えてくる。まずは５割復帰をめざせ！
reviewed_cases.english: A strong series could get us back to .500. Start there.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Depending on the outcome of the next game, a return to a .500 record is within reach. First, aim for that .500 record!

reviewed_cases.source: 前回の対戦で叩きのめした@eがリベンジに燃えているらしい。返り討ちにして、実力の違いを見せ付けろ！
reviewed_cases.english: @e is out for revenge after our last series. Beat them again and show them it wasn't a fluke.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @e, whom you soundly defeated in your last matchup, seems to be out for revenge. Turn the tables on them and show them the difference in your skill!

reviewed_cases.source: ２軍の@t選手の最近の２軍成績はすばらしく、１軍昇格に強烈にアピールしている。一度１軍で試してはどうだろうか。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has been excellent on the farm and is making a strong case for a call-up. Give that player a chance with the first team.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t’s recent performance in the minor leagues has been outstanding, and he’s making a strong case for a promotion to the major league team. Why not give him a try in the majors?

reviewed_cases.source: 世間では今回のカードで実現される、@t選手と@u選手の黄金のルーキー対決に注目が集まる。ファンの期待に応えたい！！
reviewed_cases.english: Fans are watching the rookie showdown between @t and @u. Give them a series worth remembering.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Public attention is focused on the “golden rookie showdown” between @t and @u that will take place in this matchup. We want to live up to the fans’ expectations!!

reviewed_cases.source: 前回対決では手酷い負け方をさせられた@eとの対決がまた巡ってきた。今度こそはキッチリと借りを返してチームに弾みをつけたい。
reviewed_cases.english: @e handed us a rough loss last time. Even the score and give the team a lift.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It’s time to face @e again—the opponent who handed us a crushing defeat in our last matchup. This time, I want to settle the score once and for all and give the team a boost.

reviewed_cases.source: 連敗続きの悪い流れに、ファンの怒りも頂点に達している。プロとして、これ以上は負けられない。ファンへの謝罪の意味をこめて、今日は必勝だ！
reviewed_cases.english: The fans have had enough of this losing streak. Give them the best apology we can offer: a win today.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: With the team stuck in a losing streak, the fans’ frustration has reached a boiling point. As professionals, we simply cannot afford to lose any more games. To make amends to the fans, we absolutely must win today!

reviewed_cases.source: 次の@eとのカードには、最下位脱出がかかっている。いつまでもこの位置に甘んじているわけにはいかない！
reviewed_cases.english: This series against @e is our chance to climb out of last place. We can't stay here any longer.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Our next series against @e is crucial for us to climb out of last place. We can’t just settle for this position forever!

reviewed_cases.source: ファンは@t選手の、一刻も早い初ヒットを待っている！自信をつけさせるためにも、ぜひ達成させたい！！
reviewed_cases.english: The fans are waiting for @t to get a first hit. Getting it soon would be a real confidence boost.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Fans are eagerly awaiting Player @t’s first hit! We really want him to get it as soon as possible to boost his confidence!!

reviewed_cases.source: ファンは@t選手の、一刻も早い初勝利を待っている！自信をつけさせるためにも、ぜひ達成させたい！！
reviewed_cases.english: The fans are waiting for @t to earn a first win. Getting it soon would be a real confidence boost.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Fans are eagerly awaiting Player @t’s first win! We really want him to get that win to boost his confidence!!

reviewed_cases.source: ファンサービスの一環として始球式に著名人を招待するらしい。当日はかなりの集客が見込めるだけに、恥ずかしくない試合をしたいところだが…
reviewed_cases.english: A celebrity will throw out the first pitch, and a big crowd is expected. Give them a game worth coming for.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Apparently, as part of their fan outreach efforts, they’re inviting celebrities to throw the first pitch. Since a large crowd is expected on the day of the game, we’d like to put on a performance we can be proud of…

reviewed_cases.source: 現在連敗続きでチーム状態は思わしくないですが、@t選手は連敗ストップに燃えているようです。
reviewed_cases.english: We're in a skid, but @t is determined to stop it.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Although the team is currently on a losing streak and not in great shape, Player @t seems determined to end the losing streak.

reviewed_cases.source: 先日の@t選手の活躍がオーナーの目にも止まったようだ。次の試合はオーナー自ら観戦、活躍次第ではボーナスも出すという。
reviewed_cases.english: The owner noticed @t's last performance and will attend the next game. Another good showing could earn a bonus.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t has been showing remarkable growth recently. To help him take his game to the next level, wouldn’t it be better to foster his sense of responsibility and assign him a role that matches it?

reviewed_cases.english: @t is a seasoned player who still delivers. Let @t show the younger players how it's done.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Although Player @t has reached his prime, he continues to perform at a level that belies his age. Let’s watch @t showcase his outstanding skills and serve as a role model for the younger players.

reviewed_cases.source: 選手として大きな飛躍を遂げつつある@t選手。彼を真の中心選手に育て上げるのは私の使命だ。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is making great strides as a player. It is my mission to develop him into a true star player.

reviewed_cases.source: 数々の強敵を打ち破り、わがチームは見事日本一の称号を手にした。だが日本の外にも強敵はいる。日本一の名に恥じない戦いをみせよう。

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今シーズンは打撃好調で首位打者も夢ではありません。タイトル奪取のためにはここらで固め打ちがほしいところです。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @Player T has been hitting well this season, and the batting title is not out of reach. To clinch the title, he’ll need to put together a string of hits around this time.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今シーズンは勝負強い打撃でチームを引っ張っています。この調子ならば打点王のタイトルも充分圏内です。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has carried the team with timely hitting. Keep it up and the RBI title is well within reach.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t has been leading the team this season with his clutch hitting. If he keeps this up, he’s well within reach of the RBI title.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今シーズンはまさにチームの主砲として恥じない成績を残しています。このままいけばタイトル奪取も夢ではありません。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @Player T has truly lived up to his reputation as the team’s top slugger this season. If he keeps this up, winning a title is not just a dream.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、打撃三部門で高成績を残し、三冠同時奪取がみえてきました。ここまできたら三冠王として歴史に名を残しましょう。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t has posted strong results in all three batting categories, and a simultaneous sweep of the Triple Crown is now within reach. Now that we’ve come this far, let’s make history as the Triple Crown winner.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今シーズンはすばらしい投球をし、まさにチームの大黒柱。このまま活躍を続ければ、大きな勲章が得られるでしょう。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has anchored the staff with excellent pitching. Keep it up and the ERA title is within reach.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @Player T has pitched brilliantly this season and is truly the backbone of the team. If he continues to perform at this level, he’ll surely earn a major award.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、ここまで力強い投球で、三振の山を築いています。力ある投手の証でもある奪三振。このタイトルも狙えるか。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has racked up strikeouts with overpowering stuff. Can that arm take the league strikeout title?
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t has been pitching with such power so far, racking up a mountain of strikeouts. Strikeouts are a hallmark of a powerful pitcher. Could he be in the running for this title as well?

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今季は多くの勝ち星をもたらしチームに貢献しています。チームとしても彼のタイトル獲得をあと押ししたいところです。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has won a lot of games for us this season. Let's do our part to help secure the wins title.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t has contributed greatly to the team this season by racking up many wins. As a team, we’d like to help him win a title.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、今季は大車輪の活躍で、主要な投手タイトルを総なめにしそうな勢いです。彼には球界に名を残してもらいたい。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has been outstanding and could sweep the major pitching titles. That would be a season to remember.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @Player T has been on a roll this season and looks poised to sweep all the major pitching titles. I hope he goes down in baseball history.

reviewed_cases.source: 着実に成長し、今やチーム屈指の飛距離を誇る@t選手ですが、次のステップを踏むために今一度確実性のある打撃を教えたいと思います。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t has grown steadily and now boasts one of the longest hits on the team, but to help him take the next step, I want to teach him how to hit with more consistency.

reviewed_cases.source: 確実性も身につき、相手にとって脅威の打者となりつつある@t選手ですが、メンタル面も鍛え直し、さらなる成長を期待したい。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has become a dangerous, consistent hitter. More work on the mental side could take that bat even further.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is becoming a threat to opposing teams as he gains consistency, and we hope he will continue to grow by strengthening his mental game as well.

reviewed_cases.source: 精神面も成長し、打者として完成されつつある@t選手。これからもスタンドに向けて虹のアーチをかけてくれるに違いありません。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is maturing as a hitter. Expect plenty more balls to arc into the stands.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t has grown mentally and is becoming a well-rounded hitter. There’s no doubt he’ll continue to send rainbow arcs soaring into the stands.

reviewed_cases.source: 脚力を活かしリードオフマンとしての地位を固めたい@t選手ですが、そのためにはとにかく塁にでる確率を上げねばなりません。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has the speed to be our leadoff hitter. To hold that spot, that player needs to reach base more often.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t wants to solidify his position as a leadoff hitter by making the most of his speed, but to do so, he must above all increase his on-base percentage.

reviewed_cases.source: 打席でのしぶとさが身についてきた@t選手。さらにチームの得点源となるために、打球を見てからのスタートの技術をみがいていきます。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is tougher to retire now. We'll work on getting a good jump when the ball is put in play so that speed leads to runs.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t has developed a tenacious approach at the plate. To become an even greater source of runs for the team, he will continue to hone his technique for timing his start after watching the ball.

reviewed_cases.source: 最も塁に出したくない選手の一人としてマークされつつある@t選手。このマークを跳ね除けてこそ真のリードオフマンではないだろうか。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is increasingly being labeled as one of the players opponents least want to get on base. Isn’t a true leadoff hitter someone who can shake off that label?

reviewed_cases.source: 着実に成長し、隙のない打者となりつつある@t選手ですが、さらなる高みをめざすために、今一度打撃フォームのチェックを行います。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is becoming a complete hitter. We'll review the swing again to see what can still improve.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is steadily improving and is on his way to becoming a well-rounded hitter, but to reach even greater heights, we’ll take another look at his batting form.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is undergoing various trials and errors in pursuit of even greater heights. Isn’t this truly a time to be patient until results start to show?

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is steadily developing into a key member of the rotation, but we’ll help him master the pitching skills he needs to take his game to the next level.

reviewed_cases.source: 頼もしい投球でチームに不可欠な存在になりつつある@t選手。結果を残すことでエースとしての自覚と責任が身につけばよいのですが。

reviewed_cases.english: @t is developing into the kind of starter who makes the whole team expect to win.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is gradually earning the trust of his teammates with his steady performance on the mound. The more he pitches, the more that trust is sure to grow.

reviewed_cases.english: @t is part of our late-inning plan. Seeing that pitcher come in lifts our team and puts doubt in the other dugout.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It is no easy task to aim to be a player who is “flawless in every respect.” Player @t seems to be taking on that challenge.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: If Player @t has a track record of stealing multiple bases in a single game, their influence on the opposing battery will increase, making them an even more formidable player.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t excels in every aspect—hitting, power, and baserunning. Prove that he’s a threat to opposing teams.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: “Reach even further.” Isn’t this the aspiration shared by every batter? Player @t has set out on a journey to become the greatest slugger.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Naturally, power hitters are expected to drive in runs. Player @t approaches each game with a focus on hitting to bring runners home.

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: The ability to hit for power is one of the attractions of a power hitter. Player @t will focus more on hitting for power in the next game.

reviewed_cases.english: Home runs define a slugger. If @t goes deep when it matters, pitchers will have one more reason to be careful.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: When you think of a power hitter, home runs are the first thing that comes to mind. If Player @t can hit a home run in a clutch situation, he’ll be a real threat to the opposing team.

reviewed_cases.source: チャンスでの長打は、チームの勝利に大きく影響します。そういった勝負強さも@t選手が一流の強打者になるために必要だと思います。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Hitting for power in clutch situations has a major impact on a team’s victory. I believe that kind of clutch performance is essential for @t to become a top-tier power hitter.

reviewed_cases.source: 試合中に必ずあるであろう、一発長打を求められる場面で結果を残せてこそ@t選手をスラッガーと呼ぶにふさわしいのではないでしょうか。
reviewed_cases.english: A true slugger delivers when one big hit is needed. Look for @t to seize that chance.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Isn’t it only when Player @t delivers in those moments during a game—when a big hit is absolutely needed—that he truly deserves to be called a slugger?

reviewed_cases.source: ボールを捉えられても、安打にならなければ出塁できません。@t選手は安打性の打球を打つことを目標とします。

reviewed_cases.english: A good eye helps you get more hits. In the next game, @t will look for a pitch to drive.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: To increase your batting average, you also need to learn how to read the ball. Player @t will go into the next game with a stronger focus on waiting for pitches in the strike zone.

reviewed_cases.english: Once you can lay off borderline pitches, you have to punish mistakes. @t will work on doing that consistently.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Once you can identify borderline pitches, you’ll need the skill to consistently hit the good ones. Player @t is working on honing that skill.

reviewed_cases.english: Squaring up the ball leads to more hits. @t is working on the bat control to do it consistently.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: If you can make solid contact with the ball, your chances of getting a hit increase. Player @t strives to develop the bat control needed to make solid contact with the ball.

reviewed_cases.source: ボールの見極め、的確なバットコントロールで安打を量産する。@t選手は相手チームにとって脅威の存在となるだろう。
reviewed_cases.english: With a good eye and precise bat control, @t can pile up hits and give opposing pitchers trouble.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: By reading the ball and exercising precise bat control, he racks up hits. Player @t will be a threat to opposing teams.

reviewed_cases.source: 足が速いというのは、チームにとって大きな武器となるでしょう。@t選手はまず足で相手チームをかく乱します。

reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Having speed is a major asset for any team. Player @t first uses his speed to disrupt the opposing team.

reviewed_cases.english: Speed only matters if you get on base. The first priority for @t is finding a way aboard.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Being fast on your feet alone isn’t enough to pose a threat to the opponent. Isn’t it important for Player @t to get on base in any way possible?

reviewed_cases.source: 塁に出せばいつ走ってくるかわからない。それくらい@t選手が警戒されるようになれば、チームにとって大きな武器となるでしょう。
reviewed_cases.english: If opponents worry that @t could take off at any moment, that speed becomes a real weapon.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Once he’s on base, you never know when he’ll start running. If Player @t becomes that much of a threat, he’ll be a major asset to the team.

reviewed_cases.source: 出塁率を上げることができれば、その分足を活かす機会も増えます。@t選手は理想のリードオフマンをめざします。
reviewed_cases.english: Getting on base more often creates more chances to use speed. @t is working to become the ideal leadoff hitter.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: If you can increase your on-base percentage, you’ll have more opportunities to use your speed. Player @t aims to be the ideal leadoff hitter.

reviewed_cases.source: 時には相手チームのウラをついた作戦で、走力を活かすことも必要だと思います。@t選手は次の試合で意表をつく作戦を実行します。
reviewed_cases.english: Sometimes you have to surprise the defense to use your speed. @t will try that in the next game.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: I think it’s sometimes necessary to use strategies that catch the opposing team off guard and take advantage of a player’s speed. Player @t will execute a surprise strategy in the next game.

reviewed_cases.source: 多くの出塁機会が得られれば、あとはそのチャンスを活かし、@t選手の自慢の足で相手をかく乱させましょう。
reviewed_cases.english: Once you get on base more often, make those chances count. Let @t's speed put pressure on the defense.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: If you can create plenty of opportunities to get on base, make the most of those chances and use Player @t’s speed to throw the opponent off balance.

reviewed_cases.source: コースによって広角に打ち分けないと強い打球を飛ばすことができません。あえて流し打ちを徹底させ、アウトコースのボールの対応を練習させます。
reviewed_cases.english: Use the whole field to drive pitches in different locations. Practice hitting outside pitches the other way.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Depending on the pitch, players cannot hit the ball hard unless they adjust their swing to hit to different parts of the field. We deliberately focus on teaching players to hit the ball to the opposite field and have them practice handling pitches on the outside corner.

reviewed_cases.source: 打球を強く叩かせるために、引っ張りを意識させた早い始動を身につけさせます。内角の速球にも差し込まれない力強いスイングをめざします。
reviewed_cases.english: Start the swing earlier and work on pulling the ball. A strong swing can turn on a fastball inside.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: To help players hit the ball with more power, we’ll teach them to initiate their swing early while focusing on pulling the ball. The goal is to develop a powerful swing that won’t be overpowered even by fastballs on the inside corner.

reviewed_cases.source: どうしても点の欲しい場面ではバントも消極的な作戦ではありません。普段の反復練習を徹底させ、どんな場面でも動じない技術を身につけさせます。
reviewed_cases.english: When a run is vital, a bunt can be the right call. Repeat the drill until you can execute it under pressure.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: In situations where you absolutely need to score, a bunt is not a passive strategy. We emphasize thorough, repetitive practice to ensure players develop the skills to remain composed in any situation.

reviewed_cases.source: 今月の@t選手はまさに絶好調で、今月のＭＶＰを狙える位置にきています。チャンスですし獲得して勢いにしてほしいですね。
reviewed_cases.english: @t is on a tear this month and could win Monthly MVP. Take the opportunity and keep that momentum going.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t is in top form this month and is in a position to win the MVP award. This is a great opportunity, so I hope he wins it and uses that momentum to his advantage.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、相手打者をかわしにいったところを痛打される場面がめだちます。時には思い切った投球も重要だと思うのですが。
reviewed_cases.english: @t has been getting hit hard while trying to pitch around hitters. Sometimes the best move is to challenge them.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t stands out for those moments when he tries to avoid the opposing batter only to get hit hard. I think it’s important to take risks with his pitching sometimes, though.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手ですが、序盤から飛ばしすぎているためか、中盤以降の粘りがありません。スタミナ配分を考えた投球を心がけさせようと思います。
reviewed_cases.english: @t may be going too hard early and fading from the middle innings on. Work on pacing to make that stamina last.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @Player T seems to be pushing too hard from the start, which may be why he lacks stamina in the middle and late innings. I’m going to have him focus on pitching in a way that conserves his stamina.

reviewed_cases.source: @t選手は自分で限界を決めるクセがあるのか、疲労がたまると腕が下がりがちになるようです。あえて彼を酷使してみてはいかかでしょう。
reviewed_cases.english: @t tends to drop the arm slot when tired. Try extending an outing to help that pitcher push past that point.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: @t Player seems to have a tendency to set his own limits; when he gets tired, his arm tends to drop. Why not try pushing him to his limits on purpose?

reviewed_cases.source: 失点のほとんどは投球ミスから生まれるものです。狙った位置に最高のボールを投げる。投手としての永遠のテーマに挑ませます。
reviewed_cases.english: Mistakes on the mound lead to runs. Work on throwing a well-executed pitch to the spot you picked.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Most runs scored result from pitching errors. Throw the perfect pitch to the exact spot you aim for. Take on this eternal challenge for every pitcher.

reviewed_cases.source: 救援登板ではほんの１球の失投が命取りです。ミスを少なくすること、すなわち制球の重要性を@t選手に充分説くことにします。
reviewed_cases.english: One missed spot can cost a reliever the game. We'll work with @t on the command needed to limit those mistakes.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: In relief appearances, even a single bad pitch can be fatal. I’ll make sure to thoroughly explain to Player @t the importance of minimizing mistakes—that is, the importance of control.

reviewed_cases.source: ペナントレースも終盤に入り、@t選手のタイトル獲得も現実味を帯びてきました。チームとしても最大限の協力をしてやりたいものです。
reviewed_cases.english: The season is winding down, and @t has a real chance at a title. Give that player all the support we can.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: As the pennant race enters its final stages, @t’s chances of winning a title are looking more and more realistic. As a team, we want to do everything we can to support him.

reviewed_cases.source: 最近めっきり出番の減った@t選手ですが、このまま終わる選手じゃないと思います。出場させれば結果を出してくれると思うのですが。
reviewed_cases.english: @t hasn't played much lately but still has something to offer. Give that player another chance to produce.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t hasn’t been seeing much playing time lately, but I don’t think this is how his career will end. I believe he’ll deliver results if given the chance to play.

reviewed_cases.source: 交流戦も前半を終え、かなり良い成績で折り返すことができました。これは交流戦優勝も充分手が届く位置ですのでここは是非狙ってみましょう。
reviewed_cases.english: We're halfway through interleague play and in a strong position. The top spot is within reach, so go after it.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: We’ve finished the first half of the Interleague Play and managed to turn the season around with some pretty good results. Since we’re now well within reach of winning the Interleague Play title, let’s definitely aim for it.

reviewed_cases.source: 明日からチームは長期の連戦に突入します。投手のローテーションや野手の疲労などをうまくケアし、この連戦を何とか乗り切りましょう！
reviewed_cases.english: A long stretch of games starts tomorrow. Manage the rotation and keep the fielders fresh to get through it.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Starting tomorrow, the team will embark on a long stretch of consecutive games. Let’s manage the pitching rotation and fielders’ fatigue carefully so we can make it through this stretch!

reviewed_cases.source: 監督の教えを受け、大きく成長しようとしている@t選手。期待に応えるためにも、監督にその成長した姿を見せつけよう！
reviewed_cases.english: Working with the manager has helped @t grow. Put that progress on display and show what the coaching has done.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @t is making great strides under the manager’s guidance. To live up to expectations, show the manager just how much you’ve improved!

reviewed_cases.source: 豪腕で知られる@u選手ですが、最近@t選手にアドバイスしているみたいです。優れた技術を吸収してくれればと思います。
reviewed_cases.english: @u is known for a powerful arm and has been giving @t advice. Let's see what that pitcher learns from it.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: Player @u is known for his powerful arm, but it seems he’s been giving advice to Player @t lately. I hope Player @t will be able to absorb these excellent techniques.

reviewed_cases.source: @u選手の衰え知らずのスタミナを学ぼうと、@t選手が調整法など熱心に話を聞いているようです。成果が楽しみです。
reviewed_cases.english: @u has remarkable stamina, and @t has been asking about that routine. Let's see what comes of it.
reviewed_cases.deepl_comparison: It seems that @t is listening intently to @u’s advice on training methods, hoping to learn from his seemingly inexhaustible stamina. I’m looking forward to seeing the results.
